args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
June,

PHL label confusion on the Pellow Home Living account:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Old CRM code CLR, new code PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal), so filtering on PHL returns both. The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Use the full name in subject lines and filings, not PHL.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label changed to Pellow Home Living.
- The Pemberline Dock export still shows the old Covey & Lark Retail heading, so the receiving desk sees a mismatch.
- Ask: update the CRM name and code, the saved report label, and the export heading, then confirm when done.

Thanks
